profile.quote: Deloitte Haskins & Sells Chartered Accountants LLP (Firm Registration No. 117364W/W100739) is a firm of Chartered Accountants registered with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (“ICAI”) and is part of the Deloitte network of professional services firms. The firm has extensive experience in providing audit and assurance services to large listed and multinational companies across various sectors, including pharmaceuticals, life sciences and healthcare.
